theory.heading: What Django Admin Customisation is
theory.body: Django Admin Customisation describes the methods and patterns used within Python Full Stack to achieve reliable, maintainable results. Understanding it is the foundation for everything built later in this course.

theory.heading: Why Django Admin Customisation matters
theory.body: Without Django Admin Customisation, systems built with Python Full Stack are harder to debug, extend and operate. Teams that master this topic ship fewer defects and communicate more clearly about design decisions.

theory.heading: How Django Admin Customisation works
theory.body: The mechanism behind Django Admin Customisation follows a repeatable sequence: understand the requirement, apply the principle, verify the result and refine based on feedback. Each step has checks that keep the work on track.

theory.heading: Advantages and limitations of Django Admin Customisation
theory.body: Django Admin Customisation offers structure, clarity and consistency, but it also adds overhead and may be overkill for trivial tasks. Use it when the benefit in reliability outweighs the added effort.
